title: Deliver Rubber to Slufingway-on-sea Factory
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Rubber** delivered to **Slufingway-on-sea Factory** (industry id 10, near tile 12,49).

A likely supplier is **Chadston Rubber Plantation** (industry id 7, near tile 14,30); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.
